'''Vaskus Kayle''' was a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Kayle was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and served with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] in the [[battle of Kalandis Seven]], during which he helped to destroy the local Imperial&ndash;[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] controlled [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]].

==Biography==
Vaskus Kayle served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} As "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" takes place after the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], and Malcom states it has been 40 years since the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]], the story must thus take place in 3640 BBY.</ref> Kayle was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and served with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] during the [[battle of Kalandis Seven]]. During the course of the battle, Kayle and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was tasked with the destruction of [[Kalandis Seven]]'s local [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|Imperial spaceport]]. On the way to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Kayle and the squad were attacked, and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]] was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded. Kayle's sergeant activated Keioidian's [[med tracer]] before ordering the squad to move out, leaving Keioidian behind. Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, Kayle and the squad finally reached the spaceport and started planting [[targeting beacon]]s. Shortly after they planted the last of the beacons, the spaceport was destroyed.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Personality and traits==
According to Shanra Immel, Vaskus Kayle was not a good shot, knew his own faults and how to follow orders, and would probably poison himself someday from his inability to read labels. Kayle was also a [[null-racket]] player and, according to Jace Malcolm, knew how to play a mean game.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vaskus Kayle first appeared, albeit via voice only, in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story, "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]," which was published within the [[Star Wars Insider 137|137th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> and released on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
